name: GhostSlider
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostSlider. Same behavioral props plus tone and size. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes track, range, and thumb recipes to this instance.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color intent for the range fill and thumb ring.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Unstyled root inside the themed scope.

parts.name: range
parts.description: Accent fill between thumbs or from min.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-primary-bg
cssProperties.description: Default range fill and thumb ring.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-track-thickness-sm
cssProperties.description: Track and range thickness for size sm. Density-independent.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-track-thickness-md
cssProperties.description: Track and range thickness for size md. Density-independent.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-track-thickness-lg
cssProperties.description: Track and range thickness for size lg. Density-independent.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-track-target
cssProperties.description: Minimum pointer hit size around the track cross axis and the thumb.
